usage.title: Usage and spend
usage.lead: What AI costs today, who is using it and which caps apply.
usage.estimateNote: Estimate: costs are computed from logged tokens and the models' list prices. They are not Anthropic's invoice, which may differ.
usage.truncated: Only the {n} most recent rows were read: totals for the earliest days are partial.
usage.classificationHint: Part of today's spend, with its own cap inside the global limit.

usage.utcNote: Days follow UTC, like the daily caps.
usage.emptyTitle: No usage logged in the last {days} days
usage.emptyBody: Rows appear when someone uses the chat, generates a brief or a classification runs.

kill.title: AI kill switch
kill.onHint: Chat, briefs and mention classification are running, within the caps below.
kill.offHint: Chat, briefs and mention classification are stopped for every user until you turn AI back on. Data already computed stays available.
kill.confirmSuspend: Suspend all AI calls for every user?
kill.confirmResume: Turn AI calls back on for every user?
kill.error: The state could not be changed. Try again.
kill.missing: The AI state cannot be read: the ai.enabled key is missing from the configuration.

caps.title: Caps
caps.lead: They apply from the next use. Every change goes to the audit log.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Every write to weights, sources, roles, briefs and configuration. The log is read-only.

users.title: Users and roles
users.lead: Everyone who has signed up, with organisation and role.

can.admin: Everything, including sources, weights, users, audit log and publishing briefs.
can.analyst: Runs pipelines, reviews taxonomy mappings and briefs, edits weight sets.
can.member: Reads all cells, uses the chat, saves watchlists, creates product passports, exports.
can.viewer: Reads published sheets and briefs only.
